# PKD Studio

> PKD Studio is a premier luxury interior design and architecture practice based in Mumbai, India. Founded by Principal Designer Prachiti Khanvilkar, the studio specializes in bespoke residential design, commercial spaces, adaptive reuse, and high-end hospitality interiors across India.

## Business Summary
- **Name**: PKD Studio
- **Founder & Principal Designer**: Prachiti Khanvilkar (27+ years of experience)
- **Established**: 2017
- **Completed Projects**: 75+ residential, commercial, workplace, and hospitality projects
- **Location**: 317, Vasan Udyog Bhavan, Senapati Bapat Marg, opposite Palladium Mall, Lower Parel West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400013, India
- **Website**: https://pkdstudio.in
- **Email**: enquires@teampkd.in
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/pkdstudio_/
- **LinkedIn**: http://www.linkedin.com/in/prachiti-khanvilkar-412874114

## Primary Expertise & Services
- **Luxury Residential Interior Design**: Bespoke penthouses, sprawling multi-level residences, adaptive reuse homes, master suites, and custom furniture.
- **Architectural & Spatial Design**: Structural reimagination, space planning, facade integration, and indoor-outdoor spatial flow.
- **Commercial & Showroom Design**: Experiential retail spaces, luxury product showrooms, and executive workplace environments.
- **Craftsmanship & Materiality**: Selection of Michelangelo Italian marble, hand-fluted stone, artisanal metalwork, bespoke lighting, and 100% custom Indian craftsmanship.

## Featured Portfolio Projects
- **Grand Chateau (Mumbai)**: 14,000 sq. ft. adaptive reuse transformation of an industrial building into a luxury multi-level family residence.
- **Renaissance 86 (Mumbai)**: Immersive retail showroom inspired by Italian design and Italian palace architecture, featuring Pininfarina Ola curves and hand-fluted Brazilian quartz.
- **The Canvas Home (Mumbai)**: Reimagining a 4BHK into a serene 2BHK featuring a 50% dedicated master suite, subtle luxury marble finishes, and curated art installations.
- **Jade (Mumbai)**: 1,800 sq. ft. residence combining two apartments with a dual-function kitchen/bakery studio and panoramic views of Mumbai Harbour.
- **Lithic Home, Nouveau Home, 17 Altamount, Vaayu, Chetan Shah, Binoy Shah, Anil Bajaj**: High-end luxury residential and workplace projects.
